Postdoctoral Researcher (m/f/d) in Human-AI Interaction and Empirical 
LLM Research
University of Potsdam, Germany (Berlin metropolitan area)

The Professorship of Medical Ethics with a Focus on Digitalization 
(Prof. Dr. Robert Ranisch) at the University of Potsdam invites 
applications for a postdoctoral research position (50-75%, TV-L E13, 
funded for three years, starting as soon as possible).

The position focuses on empirical research into how people use, perceive 
and interact with AI systems such as large language models, chatbots, 
digital assistants and social robots, and on the social and ethical 
implications of these technologies. Responsibilities include designing, 
conducting and analyzing empirical studies, publishing and presenting 
results, contributing to research projects and grant proposals, and 
teaching.

We welcome applicants from psychology, sociology, HCI/HRI, cognitive 
science, communication studies, computer science, data science and 
related fields. Required: a PhD in a relevant discipline, practical 
experience with qualitative and/or quantitative empirical methods, an 
established research profile, initial university teaching experience, 
and excellent English (willingness to learn German). Prior expertise in 
medical ethics is not required.

The position offers opportunities for further academic qualification 
(including Habilitation); at least one-third of working time is reserved 
for independent research. Partial remote work is possible, combined with 
regular on-site presence in Potsdam.

Application deadline: November 30, 2026
Please send your application (preferably a single PDF with cover letter, 
CV, certificates, publication list and evidence of teaching experience) to:

Informal inquiries about the position and potential research directions 
are welcome.
